evidence: Fresh pinned PE import enumeration identifies WINMM.dll name:timeGetTime uniquely at0x00669368. Original Wave4C6B2B and4C698E call that IAT slot; game_init loads it into esi at58F2F4 and calls esi at58F304/58F30F; MAmbience::general loads it into edi at44736C and calls edi at44737E/447399. CMake already links winmm; use the SDK declaration, not an executable-address alias.

Read-only ownership census of all eight registered checkouts finds no existing owner for game_init58F2F0 or MAmbience::general447360. Wave subjects are already owned locally. Net and popup have separate related aliases; this finding and authority cover only these four consumers, not their existing owners or the unresolved Ambience state bank.
